messages:
anna_docs: FYI I opened a hotfix PR to the docs site after the outage — updates: status page link, 'known issues' section with workaround, small SDK retry snippet, and a changelog entry. Requesting quick review for merge this morning.

chris_eng: Thanks. Can you paste the preview link here and note the exact merge window you need? We have the customer sync at 11:00 PT.

anna_docs: Preview: https://docs-preview.internal.redwood/1749432102 — the status link currently points to the old incident URL, replaced with the canonical status.redwood page + incident id. Prefer merge between 10:30-10:45 PT so the published doc is live before the sync.

ben_sre: Quick check: make sure the workaround includes the exact curl command and the note about KV-cache warmup. Also add "affected regions" bullet (us-west/eur).

anna_docs: Good catch — added bullet and the curl example. Here's the snippet I added to SDK examples: ```python
# retry logic for transient 5xx from inference endpoint
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
for attempt in range(3):
    try:
        resp = client.generate(prompt)
        break
    except ServerError as e:
        if attempt == 2:
            raise
        time.sleep(1 + attempt*2)
```

olivia_prod: Can we also surface a one-line note under "What to expect" about degraded throughput for burst requests? Customer success will call that out.

anna_docs: Done — added: "During recovery some burst traffic may see higher latency; use prefix-caching or smaller batch sizes as a workaround."

chris_eng: I can review and merge in the 10:30 window. Two things: 1) docs preview still shows a relative link on the status page note, please make it absolute to avoid CDN cache issues, 2) add a short sentence to changelog about "emergency docs update" (one line).

anna_docs: Updated both. Also pinged @support to prep an outbound note.

docs-bot: CI: docs-preview build #412 passed — preview available: https://docs-preview.internal.redwood/1749432102 ✅

ben_sre: Reviewed the workaround wording, LGTM besides a minor grammar tweak in the curl example comment (fixed).

chris_eng: Approving now. :+1:

anna_docs: Thanks — I'll hold until 10:30 PT then request merge.

10:30 PT window

chris_eng: Merging now.

docs-bot: Merge detected: PR #2897 merged into main by chris_eng. Docs site build queued.

docs-bot: Docs build #789 deployed to production: https://docs.redwood.ai (propagation may take up to 5 min).

ben_sre: Confirmed status page link shows the right incident id and the workaround text is present.

olivia_prod: Notified customer success and support with the link and summary.

anna_docs: Closing thread — thanks for the fast reviews. I'll follow up with a short Slack update in #customer-comms with the exact published URL and changelog bullet. :tada:
